questions.question: What does Proverbs 17 say about a friend?
options: A friend quickly forgets all about you once you are dead and gone
A friend takes all that he possibly can and gives back nothing at all
A friend flees away from you at the very first sign of any trouble
A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity
questions.answer: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity

questions.question: What does Proverbs 17 say a joyful heart is?
Proverbs 17 says better is a dry morsel with quiet than a house full of feasting with strife.
